content.text: Is the crit value right under this ruleset? What about the Cleanrot set?

The ladder bans every parry skill ("All Parries" in the ash bans), and the 9-27 additions ban blocking with any shield. As far as I know a parry always needs a parry skill, so legal ripostes come only from stance breaks, plus backstabs. I haven't checked that against the skill data yet.

| Your question | What the data says |
|---|---|
| Crit value under this ruleset | The crit score still counts parry ripostes the ruleset rules out. It should count only stance-break ripostes and backstabs, with parries counted only for parry skills the ruleset allows, which here is none. |
| Cleanrot Knight's Sword set | The off hand isn't empty. ... |
| Raptor Talons with Impaling Thrust | Picked on raw damage alone ... |
| Claw paired with another claw | That pairing isn't measured. ... |

The crit and pairing problems both mean the score credits value that was never measured. I haven't fixed either.
